- Improve restaurant standards, customer experience and commercial results
- Build leadership capability, succession and stronger management teams
- Hold Restaurant General Managers accountable for performance and agreed targets
- Drive consistency across food safety, health and safety and day-to-day operations
- Support restaurant refurbishments, image modernisation projects and new openings
- Work closely with the Director of Operations and wider support teams
- Contribute ideas and insight that improve broader business performance
Skills & Experience
- Proven multi-site leadership experience
- Experience leading managers across several locations
- Strong commercial and P&L capability
- Demonstrated success improving sales, profitability and operating standards
- Strong coaching and people development skills
- Experience developing succession and future leaders
- Confident decision-making and sound commercial judgement
- Strong communication and relationship-building capability
- Experience in QSR, hospitality, retail or another high-volume customer business
- Experience with new openings or refurbishments is advantageous
- Full New Zealand Driver Licence
Ideal Candidate
A highly driven and commercially minded multi-site leader who can lift performance through others.
You will be or have delivered the Wow! in your current role.
You will be confident enough to challenge established thinking, empathetic enough to develop people and commercially sharp enough to understand what is driving results.
You will be comfortable moving between restaurant operations, leadership development and commercial decision-making.
Most importantly, you will have the capability and ambition to grow as the business grows.
Reports to: Director of Operations, New Zealand
Direct reports: Approximately 6-8 General Restaurant Managers
Travel: Regular travel across the Auckland restaurant network

job.title: Executive Chef
job.description:
A high-profile tourism and hospitality business is looking for an Executive Chef to lead a large, multi-venue culinary operation in Rotorua.
This is a senior, hands-on leadership role spanning a substantial restaurant operation, café service, events and functions in a high-volume visitor environment.
The main restaurant operates at scale with a broad, high-quality food offering designed for significant guest volumes, combining variety, presentation and consistency across service.
Working closely with the General Manager and Food & Beverage Manager, you will lead a substantial team and take responsibility for food quality, people capability, commercial performance and the effectiveness of the wider kitchen operation.

The Role
You will provide culinary leadership across multiple service environments, balancing quality, consistency, volume and commercial performance.
You will:
  • Lead food operations across multiple venues and events
  • Set and maintain consistently high standards of food quality and presentation
  • Shape kitchen direction while encouraging continuous improvement
  • Lead, coach and develop a large and diverse culinary team
  • Build a positive, accountable and high-performing kitchen culture
  • Develop capability within the team and identify future leaders
  • Take ownership of food cost, wage cost and kitchen operating performance
  • Manage budgets and contribute to forecasting and financial planning
  • Maintain strong purchasing, stock, portion and waste controls
  • Plan staffing, production and resources around forecast demand
  • Ensure kitchens operate effectively through high-volume trading and events
  • Work closely with front of house and operational teams to deliver a seamless guest experience
  • Maintain strong food safety, health and safety and compliance standards
Who We Are Looking For
You may already be an Executive Chef, an experienced Head Chef or a senior Executive Sous Chef ready for broader responsibility.
The strongest candidates are likely to come from environments where scale, volume and complexity are part of everyday operations.
That could include:
  • Large hotels or resorts
  • Cruise lines
  • Tourism and attraction-based hospitality
  • Multi-venue food and beverage operations
  • Large-scale events or function businesses
  • Other high-volume hospitality environments
What matters most is your ability to lead people, manage a complex operation and deliver strong commercial outcomes without losing sight of quality or the guest experience.

You Will Bring
  • Proven senior culinary leadership experience
  • Experience leading large and diverse kitchen teams
  • Strong commercial understanding of budgets, food cost and wage management
  • A track record of coaching, mentoring and developing people
  • Strong planning, organisation and problem-solving skills
  • Sound food safety, health and safety and compliance knowledge
  • The ability to work effectively across operational and senior leadership teams
  • Creativity balanced by strong operational discipline
About You
You will be calm, credible and commercially aware.
You will set high standards without relying on hierarchy and be comfortable moving between service, people leadership and commercial decision-making.
You will know when to be hands-on and when to step back and let your leaders lead.
You will be organised, decisive and resilient, with the communication skills to build credibility from the kitchen floor through to senior management.
Above all, you will combine strong food credentials with the ability to lead people and run a significant hospitality operation as a business.
This is an opportunity for an experienced culinary leader who enjoys scale, complexity and the challenge of making a large operation perform at its best.

job.title: Chef
job.description:
HEAD CHEF / SENIOR SOUS CHEF | CENTRAL OTAGO

Lead a kitchen doing things differently.

Hospoworld is recruiting for an experienced Chef ready to take ownership, lead a team and help shape an established Central Otago hospitality operation.
You could already be a Head Chef looking for a fresh challenge.
Or you could be a strong Senior Sous Chef ready to step up.
Both profiles will be considered.
What matters most is your capability. Strong cooking skills. Calm leadership. Commercial awareness. High standards. Confidence without ego.

A DIFFERENT KIND OF KITCHEN
This is an established, family-owned hospitality business with multiple venues.
You will be based in one location, with the support and stability of the wider operation around you.
At the heart of the kitchen is a distinctive cooking system producing generous, flavour-driven food built around quality New Zealand meats and seafood, seasonal produce, house-made sauces and sharing-style dishes.
Previous experience with this style of cooking is not required. Curiosity is.
You need to learn what already works, understand the approach, then bring your own experience and ideas to the kitchen.
There will be a proper handover, giving you time to understand the food, systems, team and operation before taking full responsibility.

THE ROLE
 For an established Head Chef, this is an opportunity to take ownership and influence the future direction of the kitchen.
For a strong Senior Sous Chef, it offers a genuine pathway into Head Chef responsibility with the right support around you.
You will take responsibility for:
  • Leading kitchen service and food standards
  • Coaching and developing the kitchen team
  • Menu development and seasonal ideas
  • Managing food cost, stock, labour and waste
  • Working closely with the owners and wider management team
WHAT YOU BRING Your current title matters less than what you can do.
You will bring:
  • Strong commercial kitchen experience
  • Confidence working with quality proteins and fresh produce
  • Good organisation during busy service
  • Sound commercial awareness around food and labour costs
  • The ability to lead people, make decisions and earn the respect of your team
The style of leadership matters.

The business is looking for confidence without ego, good judgement and consistency.

WHY MAKE THE MOVE?

 You will get genuine responsibility and influence.
You will work in a kitchen with a cooking approach that is genuinely different.
You will receive a proper handover and support.
And you will be doing it in Central Otago, with its strong food and wine culture, outdoor lifestyle and some of New Zealand’s best scenery.
This is an opportunity for a Chef who wants to lead, contribute and build a kitchen they are proud to put their name behind.
If you are an established Head Chef looking for something different, or a Senior Sous Chef ready for your next move, we would like to hear from you.

Apply through SEEK with your CV.
